name: custom-wallet-min display-agnostic panel registry

touch.notes: External-panel touch is navigation-only; the on-board physical confirm button is the sole approve/reject control (WYSIWYS preserved).

driver_family.notes: Curated driver-family member for the display-agnostic external SPI panel.
Curated driver-family member; the reference 1.69 inch panel uses this driver.
Curated driver-family member for larger external SPI panels.

physical_confirm: On-board physical confirm button stays on the security board (not the external touch); the firmware renders the dumb external SPI panel itself so WYSIWYS is preserved over the FPC.
reference_notes: Metadata only: this is the display driver-family registry the custom-wallet board-profile registry consumes (decision spec 5). The custom-wallet-min board itself is designed in the phase-02 custom-wallet-board phase; this task adds the panel metadata only.
No MCU target: this is a display-panel registry, not a signer board profile. The custom-wallet-min host MCU is ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 (tracked with the board design, not here).
Two layout variants share this registry: (A) core-behind-display over the FPC connector, (B) core-with-display with the panel mounted directly.
